title: Message/set: attachment blobId not verified to exist on disk
description:
parse_attachments calls BlobStore::validate_blob_id (format check only). No BlobStore reference is available and read_blob is not called. Attachment metadata rows are inserted referencing blob IDs that may not exist in the blob store (race condition, interrupted upload, or client bug). Subsequent Message/get would include the attachment in the response, but fetching its content via blob API would 404.

Fix: pass a BlobStore reference to parse_attachments (or validate after parsing) and call blob_store.blob_exists(blob_id) before inserting. Return invalidArguments if not found.
